rationale: PINS `part_of` FROM A CPP `#include` — Haskell's ONE textual file inclusion, and an R3 emission on the served grammar's existing `cpp` node type (253 named of 552 ids, digest 37a6b07b1a83; no grammar build or patch is needed, which is why R1 and R2 are not taken). `import Module` is a MODULE LOAD: it creates binding scope and is resolvable as `Module.item`, the OPPOSITE of a fragment, so it is `imports` (the existing 32,704 rows) and never `part_of`. Under `{-# LANGUAGE CPP #-}`, `#include "x.h"` splices the named file's text into this module BEFORE parsing; it shares this module's single scope and has no module identity — the contract's `part_of` verbatim, and the fleet's implemented `part_of` set is unanimously textual file inclusion (cpp `#include`, fsharp `#load`, php include/require, erlang `-include`, typescript reference directives). THE TARGET IS THE PART'S MODULE SYMBOL (the file STEM), NOT A PATH: the arbiter resolves target strings against symbol NAMES and has no space for a path (the cpp lane measured 0 resolved of 4,612 rows when it emitted paths), while the contract permits either ('the part's file OR ITS MODULE SYMBOL'); the written path is kept in `metadata.partPath` so the file identity is evidence, not the target. FIRE: (1) `#include "MachDeps.h"` -> module scope `PartOfIncludes` part_of `MachDeps`, partRole 'library' (this file is the unit and the directive names its part), partPath 'MachDeps.h', line 39; (2) `#include "Local/WidgetConfig.h"` -> part_of `WidgetConfig`, the DIRECTORY stripped because the stem is the symbol, partPath 'Local/WidgetConfig.h', line 40. FORBID — the four impostor classes the whole-population census measured in the real corpus, every one of which carries the directive's TEXT without being a directive: (A) a string-built line `["#include \"" ++ header ++ "\""]` is DATA — no part_of to `header`; (B) the `-#include` GHC flag as a string literal — no part_of to `include`; (C) a Haddock mention of the flag — prose, no edge; (D) a JSON quasiquote carrying `#include <unix.h>` — quasiquote bodies are OPAQUE text (grammar: one `quasiquote_body` token), so the angle include there is not a directive and must produce neither part_of to `unix` nor imports to `unix.h`. An exact count pin (part_of = 2) keeps C and D silent; the forbid rows name A and B by their own endpoints so a regression cannot hide behind the count. Also pinned: the PATH is never the target (forbid part_of target 'Local/WidgetConfig.h'), and no symbol is fabricated for either header stem.
